items.title: What's dragging down the S&P 500? Apple in focus
items.summary: Yahoo Finance Markets and Data Editor Jared Blikre joins Deirdre Bosa on Deirdre Bosa Live to discuss Apple's (AAPL) influence on the S&P 500 (^GSPC). Blikre examines what's driving the latest weakness on Wall Street.

items.title: Eli Lilly is trouncing Nvidia — and the weight-loss drug trade is beating AI again
items.summary: Since its Oct. 6 record, Nvidia has shed more than $1.7 trillion in market value. Eli Lilly has added more than $250 billion over the same stretch, a gain topped only by Apple among the market's biggest stocks.

items.title: Samsung and Apple Reportedly Near Multi-Year DRAM Supply Agreement
items.summary: Samsung Electronics (USOTC:SSNHZ) and Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) are reportedly approaching an agreement for the long-term supply of dynamic random-access memory (DRAM) chips, according to South Korea’s Maeil Business Newspaper, citing unnamed industry sources. The proposed agreement would cover a period of four to five years, with deliveries expected to begin during the first half of 2027.
